title: Find the Right k
briefMd:
# Phase 1 · Find the Right k

The parcel company's help pages give one page per service, with five facts: price, weight limit, delivery time, size limit and insurance ("A large parcel costs 18 euros to send."). For half the services there are also one or two news pages that repeat the service's name and the questions people ask, without answering any of them. Those pages rank close to the real page, often above it. For the other half, the real page is a clear first.

You control **top-k**: how many pages are retrieved and sent as context. Retrieval is BM25, and every page is one chunk. Too few pages and the real one is missing when news pages crowd it. Too many and every question pays for pages it does not need.

**Gates:** recall@k ≥ 0.90 and mean prompt tokens ≤ 200 on the hidden set.
